name: Amazon Athena
sku: Amazon Athena SQL and Apache Spark on Athena.

serve.query-engine.note: An interactive query service that runs standard SQL directly on data in S3 with no infrastructure to manage, scaling automatically and charging only for the queries you run.

transform.code-transform.note: Apache Spark applications can be developed in Python in a notebook in the Athena console, or through the Athena Spark APIs.

bands.note: Workgroups carry per-query and per-workgroup limits on data scanned. A query over its limit is cancelled, and workgroup thresholds can raise Amazon SNS alerts. This controls query spend but does not attribute cost to datasets.

presentation.tagline: Serverless SQL over data in S3, billed per query.
